meaning:
ἐνδιδύσκω
[in LXX: 2Ki.1:24 13:18, Pro.31:21 (לָבַשׁ), Jdth.9:1 10:3, Sir.50:11 * ;]
to put on: with dupl. accusative, Mrk.15:17 (ἐνδύουσι, Rec.). Mid., to put on oneself, be clothed in: with accusative of thing(s), Luk.16:19 (cf. MM, Exp., xii).†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: They clothed him with purple, and weaving a crown of thorns, they put it on him.
“Now there was a certain rich man, and he was clothed in purple and fine linen, living in luxury every day.
